title: One-Action Microgames — Connect the Idea

scenes.title: Connect the idea microgame
scenes.purpose: A single-tap microgame: cue the goal, press one button, and the dim idea switches into a lit, connected system.
visuals: White goal pill 'GOAL: CONNECT THE IDEA'
Dim idea bulb with six loose dashed-circle nodes (cue state)
Pink TAP button with rotating dashed ring
Lit bulb, rays, warm glow, six green links and docked green square nodes (result state)
'SYSTEM ONLINE!' banner and '+6 LINKS' score pill

beats.development: Cue: goal pill and the single TAP control pop in; the ring turns and the button pulses while dim, loose nodes bob around the unlit bulb.
captions: LEVEL 1 · An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Action: the fingertip presses TAP; the cap squashes, a white ripple expands, the ring dissolves and '1 ACTION · PRESSED' appears.
Outcome: the bulb lights and smiles, rays and glow bloom, six links shoot out and the nodes snap into a hexagon, morphing from dashed circles to solid green squares; the banner and score pop in.
Settled result hold: connected system, banner and score fully legible and still.

findings: Cue, action and outcome fit the 3 s preview with the outcome starting within 0.1 s of the press.
All motion settles by 2.1 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.1–3.0 s: reading hold on the result state and score.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
STYLE.json lists no tech.preview_recipes; the preview demonstrates the core cue → one action → outcome structure.
No BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json supplied; background follows the scene-dependent policy using the illustration's indigo arena.
